abbott_smith_html:
ἐάν, contr. fr. εἰ ἄν,
conditional particle,
representing something as "under certain circumstances actual or liable to happen," but not so definitely expected as in the case of εἰ with ind. (Bl., §65, 4; cf. Jhn.13:17, 1Co.7:36), if haply, if;
__1. with subjc. (cl.);
__(a) pres.: Mat.6:22, Luk.10:6, Jhn.7:17, Rom.2:25, 26 al.;
{ __(b) aor. (= Lat. fut. pf.): Mat.4:9 16:26 (cf. ptcp. in Luk.9:25; M, Pr., 230), Mrk.3:24, Luk.14:34, Jhn.5:43, Rom.7:2, al.; = cl. εἰ, with opt., Jhn.9:22 11:57, Act.9:2; as Heb. אִם = ὅταν, Jhn.12:32 14:3, I Jhn.2:28 3:2, Heb.3:7" (LXX) .
__2. C. indic, (as in late writers, fr. Arist. on; see WH, App., 171; VD, MGr. 2, App., §77; Deiss., BS, 201f., LAE, 155, 254; M, Pr., 168, 187; Bl., §65, 4);
__(a) fut.: Mat.18:19 T, Luk.19:40, Act.7:7;
__(b) pres.: 1Th.3:8 (see Milligan, in l.).
__3. With other particles: ἐ. καί (Bl., §65, 6), Gal.6:1; ἐ. μή (M, Pr., 185, 187; Bl., l.with), with subjc. pres., Mat.10:13, 1Co.8:8, Jas.2:17, 1Jn.3:21; aor., Mat.6:15, Mrk.3:27, Jhn.3:3, Rom.10:15, Gal.1:8 2:16 (see Lft., Ellic., in ll.); ἐ. τε . . . ἐ. τε, [in LXX for אִם . . . אִם, Est.19:13, al.,] Rom.14:8.
__4. = cl. ἄν (which see) after relat. pronouns and adverbs (Tdf., Pr., 96; WH, App., 173; M, Pr., 42f.; Bl., §26, 4; Mayser, 152f.; Deiss., BS, 202ff.): ὃς ἐ., Mat.5:19, Mrk.6:22, 23 Luk.17:32, 1Co.6:18, al.; ὅπου ἐ., Mat.8:19; ὁσάκις ἐ., Rev.11:6; οὗ ἐ., 1Co.16:6; καθὸ ἐ., 2Co.8:12; ὅστις ἐ., Gal.5:10.
(AS)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: a conditional particle; in case that, provided, etc.; often used in connection with other particles to denote indefiniteness or uncertainty
strongs_1890.kjv_def: before, but, except, (and) if, (if) so, (what-, whither-)soever, though, when (-soever), whether (or), to whom, (who-)so(-ever)

occurrences.bsb: “All this I will give You,” he said, “if You will fall down and worship me.”
occurrences.kjv: And saith unto him, All these things will I give thee, if thou wilt fall down and worship me.

occurrences.bsb: You are the salt of the earth. But if the salt loses its savor, how can it be made salty again? It is no longer good for anything, except to be thrown out and trampled by men.
occurrences.kjv: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.

occurrences.bsb: So then, whoever breaks one of the least of these commandments and teaches others to do likewise will be called least in the kingdom of heaven; but whoever practices and teaches them will be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
occurrences.kjv: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven: but whosoever shall do and teach them, the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.

occurrences.kjv: For I say unto you, That except your righteousness shall exceed the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees, ye shall in no case enter into the kingdom of heaven.

occurrences.bsb: So if you are offering your gift at the altar and there remember that your brother has something against you,
occurrences.kjv: Therefore if thou bring thy gift to the altar, and there rememberest that thy brother hath ought against thee;

occurrences.bsb: But I tell you that anyone who divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, brings adultery upon her. And he who marries a divorced woman commits adultery.
occurrences.kjv: But I say unto you, That whosoever shall put away his wife, saving for the cause of fornication, causeth her to commit adultery: and whosoever shall marry her that is divorced committeth adultery.

occurrences.bsb: If you love those who love you, what reward will you get? Do not even tax collectors do the same?
occurrences.kjv: For if ye love them which love you, what reward have ye? do not even the publicans the same?

occurrences.bsb: And if you greet only your brothers, what are you doing more than others? Do not even Gentiles do the same?
occurrences.kjv: And if ye salute your brethren only, what do ye more than others? do not even the publicans so?

occurrences.bsb: For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.
occurrences.kjv: For if ye forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you:

occurrences.bsb: But if you do not forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive yours.
occurrences.kjv: But if ye forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.

occurrences.bsb: The eye is the lamp of the body. If your eyes are good, your whole body will be full of light.
occurrences.kjv: The light of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light.

occurrences.bsb: But if your eyes are bad, your whole body will be full of darkness. If then the light within you is darkness, how great is that darkness!
occurrences.kjv: But if thine eye be evil, thy whole body shall be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in thee be darkness, how great is that darkness!

occurrences.bsb: In everything, then, do to others as you would have them do to you. For this is the essence of the Law and the Prophets.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.

occurrences.bsb: Suddenly a leper came and knelt before Him, saying, “Lord, if You are willing, You can make me clean.”
occurrences.kjv: And, behold, there came a leper and worshipped him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.

occurrences.bsb: And one of the scribes came to Him and said, “Teacher, I will follow You wherever You go.”
occurrences.kjv: And a certain scribe came, and said unto him, Master, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.

occurrences.bsb: She said to herself, “If only I touch His cloak, I will be healed.”
occurrences.kjv: For she said within herself, If I may but touch his garment, I shall be whole.

occurrences.bsb: If the home is worthy, let your peace rest on it, but if it is not, let your peace return to you.
occurrences.kjv: And if the house be worthy, let your peace come upon it: but if it be not worthy, let your peace return to you.

occurrences.bsb: Blessed is the one who does not fall away on account of Me.”
occurrences.kjv: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.

occurrences.bsb: All things have been entrusted to Me by My Father. No one knows the Son except the Father, and no one knows the Father except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal Him.
occurrences.kjv: All things are delivered unto me of my Father: and no man knoweth the Son, but the Father; neither knoweth any man the Father, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him.

occurrences.bsb: He replied, “If one of you has a sheep and it falls into a pit on the Sabbath, will he not take hold of it and lift it out?
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto them, What man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift it out?

occurrences.bsb: Or again, how can anyone enter a strong man’s house and steal his possessions, unless he first ties up the strong man? Then he can plunder his house.
occurrences.kjv: Or else how can one enter into a strong man’s house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.

occurrences.bsb: Whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven, either in this age or in the one to come.
occurrences.kjv: And whosoever speaketh a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but whosoever speaketh against the Holy Ghost, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the world to come.

occurrences.bsb: so much that he promised with an oath to give to her whatever she asked.
occurrences.kjv: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatsoever she would ask.

occurrences.bsb: But you say that if anyone says to his father or mother, ‘Whatever you would have received from me is a gift devoted to God,’
occurrences.kjv: But ye say, Whosoever shall say to his father or his mother, It is a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me;

occurrences.bsb: Disregard them! They are blind guides. If a blind man leads a blind man, both will fall into a pit.”
occurrences.kjv: Let them alone: they be blind leaders of the blind. And if the blind lead the blind, both shall fall into the ditch.

occurrences.bsb: I will give you the keys of the kingdom of heaven. Whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven.”
occurrences.kjv: And I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.

occurrences.bsb: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for My sake will find it.
occurrences.kjv: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it.

occurrences.bsb: What will it profit a man if he gains the whole world, yet forfeits his soul? Or what can a man give in exchange for his soul?
occurrences.kjv: For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?

occurrences.bsb: “Because you have so little faith,” He answered. “For truly I tell you, if you have faith the size of a mustard seed, you can say to this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move. Nothing will be impossible for you.”
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.

occurrences.bsb: “Truly I tell you,” He said, “unless you change and become like little children, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven.
occurrences.kjv: And said, Verily I say unto you, Except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.

occurrences.bsb: And whoever welcomes a little child like this in My name welcomes Me.
occurrences.kjv: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me.

occurrences.bsb: What do you think? If a man has a hundred sheep and one of them goes astray, will he not leave the ninety-nine on the hills and go out to search for the one that is lost?
occurrences.kjv: How think ye? if a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, doth he not leave the ninety and nine, and goeth into the mountains, and seeketh that which is gone astray?

occurrences.bsb: And if he finds it, truly I tell you, he rejoices more over that one sheep than over the ninety-nine that did not go astray.
occurrences.kjv: And if so be that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoiceth more of that sheep, than of the ninety and nine which went not astray.

occurrences.bsb: If your brother sins against you, go and confront him privately. If he listens to you, you have won your brother over.
occurrences.kjv: Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee, go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone: if he shall hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother.

occurrences.bsb: But if he will not listen, take one or two others along, so that ‘every matter may be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.’
occurrences.kjv: But if he will not hear thee, then take with thee one or two more, that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.

occurrences.bsb: If he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the church. And if he refuses to listen even to the church, regard him as you would a pagan or a tax collector.
occurrences.kjv: And if he shall neglect to hear them, tell it unto the church: but if he neglect to hear the church, let him be unto thee as an heathen man and a publican.

occurrences.bsb: Truly I tell you, whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven.
occurrences.kjv: Verily I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever ye shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.

occurrences.bsb: Again, I tell you truly that if two of you on the earth agree about anything you ask for, it will be done for you by My Father in heaven.
occurrences.kjv: Again I say unto you, That if two of you shall agree on earth as touching any thing that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my Father which is in heaven.

occurrences.bsb: That is how My heavenly Father will treat each of you unless you forgive your brother from your heart.”
occurrences.kjv: So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also unto you, if ye from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses.

occurrences.bsb: ‘You also go into my vineyard,’ he said, ‘and I will pay you whatever is right.’
occurrences.kjv: And said unto them; Go ye also into the vineyard, and whatsoever is right I will give you. And they went their way.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone questions you, tell him that the Lord needs them, and he will send them right away.”
occurrences.kjv: And if any man say ought unto you, ye shall say, The Lord hath need of them; and straightway he will send them.

occurrences.bsb: “Truly I tell you,” Jesus replied, “if you have faith and do not doubt, not only will you do what was done to the fig tree, but even if you say to this mountain, ‘Be lifted up and thrown into the sea,’ it will happen.
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Verily I say unto you, If ye have faith, and doubt not, ye shall not only do this which is done to the fig tree, but also if ye shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; it shall be done.

occurrences.bsb: “I will also ask you one question,” Jesus replied, “and if you answer Me, I will tell you by what authority I am doing these things.
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I also will ask you one thing, which if ye tell me, I in like wise will tell you by what authority I do these things.

occurrences.bsb: What was the source of John’s baptism? Was it from heaven or from men?” They deliberated among themselves and said, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ He will ask, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
occurrences.kjv: The baptism of John, whence was it? from heaven, or of men? And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say unto us, Why did ye not then believe him?

occurrences.bsb: But if we say, ‘From men,’ we are afraid of the people, for they all regard John as a prophet.”
occurrences.kjv: But if we shall say, Of men; we fear the people; for all hold John as a prophet.

occurrences.bsb: Go therefore to the crossroads and invite to the banquet as many as you can find.’
occurrences.kjv: Go ye therefore into the highways, and as many as ye shall find, bid to the marriage.

occurrences.bsb: “Teacher,” they said, “Moses declared that if a man dies without having children, his brother is to marry the widow and raise up offspring for him.
occurrences.kjv: Saying, Master, Moses said, If a man die, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

occurrences.bsb: So practice and observe everything they tell you. But do not do what they do, for they do not practice what they preach.
occurrences.kjv: All therefore whatsoever they bid you observe, that observe and do; but do not ye after their works: for they say, and do not.

occurrences.bsb: At that time, if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or ‘There He is!’ do not believe it.
occurrences.kjv: Then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here is Christ, or there; believe it not.

occurrences.bsb: So if they tell you, ‘There He is, in the wilderness,’ do not go out, or, ‘Here He is, in the inner rooms,’ do not believe it.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore if they shall say unto you, Behold, he is in the desert; go not forth: behold, he is in the secret chambers; believe it not.

occurrences.bsb: Wherever there is a carcass, there the vultures will gather.
occurrences.kjv: For wheresoever the carcase is, there will the eagles be gathered together.

occurrences.bsb: But suppose that servant is wicked and says in his heart, ‘My master will be away a long time.’
occurrences.kjv: But and if that evil servant shall say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming;

occurrences.bsb: Truly I tell you, wherever this gospel is preached in all the world, what she has done will also be told in memory of her.”
occurrences.kjv: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world, there shall also this, that this woman hath done, be told for a memorial of her.

occurrences.bsb: A second time He went away and prayed, “My Father, if this cup cannot pass unless I drink it, may Your will be done.”
occurrences.kjv: He went away again the second time, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if this cup may not pass away from me, except I drink it, thy will be done.

occurrences.bsb: If this report reaches the governor, we will satisfy him and keep you out of trouble.”
occurrences.kjv: And if this come to the governor’s ears, we will persuade him, and secure you.

occurrences.bsb: Then a leper came to Jesus, begging on his knees: “If You are willing, You can make me clean.”
occurrences.kjv: And there came a leper to him, beseeching him, and kneeling down to him, and saying unto him, If thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.

occurrences.bsb: If a kingdom is divided against itself, it cannot stand.
occurrences.kjv: And if a kingdom be divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.

occurrences.bsb: If a house is divided against itself, it cannot stand.
occurrences.kjv: And if a house be divided against itself, that house cannot stand.

occurrences.bsb: Indeed, no one can enter a strong man’s house to steal his possessions unless he first ties up the strong man. Then he can plunder his house.
occurrences.kjv: No man can enter into a strong man’s house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house.

occurrences.bsb: Truly I tell you, the sons of men will be forgiven all sins and blasphemies, as many as they utter.
occurrences.kjv: Verily I say unto you, All sins shall be forgiven unto the sons of men, and blasphemies wherewith soever they shall blaspheme:

occurrences.bsb: For there is nothing hidden that will not be disclosed, and nothing concealed that will not be brought to light.
occurrences.kjv: For there is nothing hid, which shall not be manifested; neither was any thing kept secret, but that it should come abroad.

occurrences.bsb: For she kept saying, “If only I touch His garments, I will be healed.”
occurrences.kjv: For she said, If I may touch but his clothes, I shall be whole.

occurrences.bsb: And He told them, “When you enter a house, stay there until you leave that area.
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto them, In what place soever ye enter into an house, there abide till ye depart from that place.

occurrences.bsb: When the daughter of Herodias came and danced, she pleased Herod and his guests, and the king said to the girl, “Ask me for whatever you wish, and I will give it to you.”
occurrences.kjv: And when the daughter of the said Herodias came in, and danced, and pleased Herod and them that sat with him, the king said unto the damsel, Ask of me whatsoever thou wilt, and I will give it thee.

occurrences.bsb: And he swore to her, “Whatever you ask of me, I will give you, up to half my kingdom!”
occurrences.kjv: And he sware unto her, Whatsoever thou shalt ask of me, I will give it thee, unto the half of my kingdom.

occurrences.bsb: Now in holding to the tradition of the elders, the Pharisees and all the Jews do not eat until they wash their hands ceremonially.
occurrences.kjv: For the Pharisees, and all the Jews, except they wash their hands oft, eat not, holding the tradition of the elders.

occurrences.bsb: And on returning from the market, they do not eat unless they wash. And there are many other traditions for them to observe, including the washing of cups, pitchers, kettles, and couches for dining.
occurrences.kjv: And when they come from the market, except they wash, they eat not. And many other things there be, which they have received to hold, as the washing of cups, and pots, brasen vessels, and of tables.

occurrences.bsb: But you say that if a man says to his father or mother, ‘Whatever you would have received from me is Corban’ (that is, a gift devoted to God),
occurrences.kjv: But ye say, If a man shall say to his father or mother, It is Corban, that is to say, a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me; he shall be free.

occurrences.bsb: If I send them home hungry, they will faint along the way. For some of them have come a great distance.”
occurrences.kjv: And if I send them away fasting to their own houses, they will faint by the way: for divers of them came from far.

occurrences.bsb: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for My sake and for the gospel will save it.
occurrences.kjv: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel’s, the same shall save it.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone is ashamed of Me and My words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man will also be ashamed of him when He comes in His Father’s glory with the holy angels.”
occurrences.kjv: Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation; of him also shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he cometh in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.

occurrences.bsb: Whenever it seizes him, it throws him to the ground. He foams at the mouth, gnashes his teeth, and becomes rigid. I asked Your disciples to drive it out, but they were unable.”
occurrences.kjv: And wheresoever he taketh him, he teareth him: and he foameth, and gnasheth with his teeth, and pineth away: and I spake to thy disciples that they should cast him out; and they could not.

occurrences.bsb: If your hand causes you to sin, cut it off. It is better for you to enter life crippled than to have two hands and go into hell, into the unquenchable fire.
occurrences.kjv: And if thy hand offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter into life maimed, than having two hands to go into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:

occurrences.bsb: If your foot causes you to sin, cut it off. It is better for you to enter life lame than to have two feet and be thrown into hell.
occurrences.kjv: And if thy foot offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter halt into life, than having two feet to be cast into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:

occurrences.bsb: And if your eye causes you to sin, pluck it out. It is better for you to enter the kingdom of God with one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into hell,
occurrences.kjv: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out: it is better for thee to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye, than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire:

occurrences.bsb: Salt is good, but if the salt loses its saltiness, with what will you season it? Have salt among yourselves, and be at peace with one another.”
occurrences.kjv: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his saltness, wherewith will ye season it? Have salt in yourselves, and have peace one with another.

occurrences.bsb: And if a woman divorces her husband and marries another man, she commits adultery.”
occurrences.kjv: And if a woman shall put away her husband, and be married to another, she committeth adultery.

occurrences.bsb: will fail to receive a hundredfold in the present age—houses and brothers and sisters and mothers and children and fields, along with persecutions—and in the age to come, eternal life.
occurrences.kjv: But he shall receive an hundredfold now in this time, houses, and brethren, and sisters, and mothers, and children, and lands, with persecutions; and in the world to come eternal life.

occurrences.bsb: Then James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came to Jesus and declared, “Teacher, we want You to do for us whatever we ask.”
occurrences.kjv: And James and John, the sons of Zebedee, come unto him, saying, Master, we would that thou shouldest do for us whatsoever we shall desire.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone asks, ‘Why are you doing this?’ tell him, ‘The Lord needs it and will return it shortly.’”
occurrences.kjv: And if any man say unto you, Why do ye this? say ye that the Lord hath need of him; and straightway he will send him hither.

occurrences.bsb: They deliberated among themselves what they should answer: “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ He will ask, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
occurrences.kjv: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then did ye not believe him?

occurrences.bsb: “Teacher, Moses wrote for us that if a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife but no children, the man is to marry his brother’s widow and raise up offspring for him.
occurrences.kjv: Master, Moses wrote unto us, If a man’s brother die, and leave his wife behind him, and leave no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

occurrences.bsb: But when they arrest you and hand you over, do not worry beforehand what to say. Instead, speak whatever you are given at that time, for it will not be you speaking, but the Holy Spirit.
occurrences.kjv: But when they shall lead you, and deliver you up, take no thought beforehand what ye shall speak, neither do ye premeditate: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak ye: for it is not ye that speak, but the Holy Ghost.

occurrences.bsb: At that time if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or ‘There He is!’ do not believe it.
occurrences.kjv: And then if any man shall say to you, Lo, here is Christ; or, lo, he is there; believe him not:

occurrences.bsb: And truly I tell you, wherever the gospel is preached in all the world, what she has done will also be told in memory of her.”
occurrences.kjv: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world, this also that she hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her.

occurrences.bsb: and whichever house he enters, say to the owner, ‘The Teacher asks: Where is My guest room, where I may eat the Passover with My disciples?’
occurrences.kjv: And wheresoever he shall go in, say ye to the goodman of the house, The Master saith, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?

occurrences.bsb: But Peter kept insisting, “Even if I have to die with You, I will never deny You.” And all the others said the same thing.
occurrences.kjv: But he spake the more vehemently, If I should die with thee, I will not deny thee in any wise. Likewise also said they all.

occurrences.bsb: So if You worship me, it will all be Yours.”
occurrences.kjv: If thou therefore wilt worship me, all shall be thine.

occurrences.bsb: While Jesus was in one of the towns, a man came along who was covered with leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell facedown and begged Him, “Lord, if You are willing, You can make me clean.”
occurrences.kjv: And it came to pass, when he was in a certain city, behold a man full of leprosy: who seeing Jesus fell on his face, and besought him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.

occurrences.kjv: And if ye do good to them which do good to you, what thank have ye? for sinners also do even the same.

occurrences.kjv: And if ye lend to them of whom ye hope to receive, what thank have ye? for sinners also lend to sinners, to receive as much again.
