occurrences.kjv: And it came to pass, that, as they went in the way, a certain man said unto him, Lord, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.

occurrences.bsb: If a man of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; if not, it will return to you.
occurrences.kjv: And if the son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon it: if not, it shall turn to you again.

occurrences.bsb: All things have been entrusted to Me by My Father. No one knows who the Son is except the Father, and no one knows who the Father is except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal Him.”
occurrences.kjv: All things are delivered to me of my Father: and no man knoweth who the Son is, but the Father; and who the Father is, but the Son, and he to whom the Son will reveal him.

occurrences.bsb: But suppose that servant says in his heart, ‘My master will be a long time in coming,’ and he begins to beat the menservants and maidservants, and to eat and drink and get drunk.
occurrences.kjv: But and if that servant say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming; and shall begin to beat the menservants and maidens, and to eat and drink, and to be drunken;

occurrences.bsb: No, I tell you. But unless you repent, you too will all perish.
occurrences.kjv: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.

occurrences.bsb: No, I tell you. But unless you repent, you too will all perish.”
occurrences.kjv: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.

occurrences.bsb: Salt is good, but if the salt loses its savor, with what will it be seasoned?
occurrences.kjv: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be seasoned?

occurrences.bsb: Or what woman who has ten silver coins and loses one of them does not light a lamp, sweep her house, and search carefully until she finds it?
occurrences.kjv: Either what woman having ten pieces of silver, if she lose one piece, doth not light a candle, and sweep the house, and seek diligently till she find it?

occurrences.bsb: ‘No, father Abraham,’ he said, ‘but if someone is sent to them from the dead, they will repent.’
occurrences.kjv: And he said, Nay, father Abraham: but if one went unto them from the dead, they will repent.

occurrences.bsb: Then Abraham said to him, ‘If they do not listen to Moses and the Prophets, they will not be persuaded even if someone rises from the dead.’”
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto him, If they hear not Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded, though one rose from the dead.

occurrences.bsb: Watch yourselves. If your brother sins, rebuke him; and if he repents, forgive him.
occurrences.kjv: Take heed to yourselves: If thy brother trespass against thee, rebuke him; and if he repent, forgive him.

occurrences.bsb: Even if he sins against you seven times in a day, and seven times returns to say, ‘I repent,’ you must forgive him.”
occurrences.kjv: And if he trespass against thee seven times in a day, and seven times in a day turn again to thee, saying, I repent; thou shalt forgive him.

occurrences.bsb: Whoever tries to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life will preserve it.
occurrences.kjv: Whosoever shall seek to save his life shall lose it; and whosoever shall lose his life shall preserve it.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone asks, ‘Why are you untying it?’ tell him, ‘The Lord needs it.’”
occurrences.kjv: And if any man ask you, Why do ye loose him? thus shall ye say unto him, Because the Lord hath need of him.

occurrences.bsb: “I tell you,” He answered, “if they remain silent, the very stones will cry out.”
occurrences.kjv: And he answered and said unto them, I tell you that, if these should hold their peace, the stones would immediately cry out.

occurrences.bsb: They deliberated among themselves and said, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ He will ask, ‘Why did you not believe him?’
occurrences.kjv: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then believed ye him not?

occurrences.bsb: But if we say, ‘From men,’ all the people will stone us, for they are convinced that John was a prophet.”
occurrences.kjv: But and if we say, Of men; all the people will stone us: for they be persuaded that John was a prophet.

occurrences.bsb: “Teacher,” they said, “Moses wrote for us that if a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife but no children, the man is to marry his brother’s widow and raise up offspring for him.
occurrences.kjv: Saying, Master, Moses wrote unto us, If any man’s brother die, having a wife, and he die without children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

occurrences.bsb: “If You are the Christ, tell us.” Jesus answered, “If I tell you, you will not believe.
occurrences.kjv: Art thou the Christ? tell us. And he said unto them, If I tell you, ye will not believe:

occurrences.bsb: And if I ask you a question, you will not answer.
occurrences.kjv: And if I also ask you, ye will not answer me, nor let me go.

occurrences.bsb: He came to Jesus at night and said, “Rabbi, we know that You are a teacher who has come from God. For no one could perform the signs You are doing if God were not with him.”
occurrences.kjv: The same came to Jesus by night, and said unto him, Rabbi, we know that thou art a teacher come from God: for no man can do these miracles that thou doest, except God be with him.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus replied, “Truly, truly, I tell you, no one can see the kingdom of God unless he is born again.”
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus answered, “Truly, truly, I tell you, no one can enter the kingdom of God unless he is born of water and the Spirit.
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.

occurrences.bsb: If I have told you about earthly things and you do not believe, how will you believe if I tell you about heavenly things?
occurrences.kjv: If I have told you earthly things, and ye believe not, how shall ye believe, if I tell you of heavenly things?

occurrences.bsb: John replied, “A man can receive only what is given him from heaven.
occurrences.kjv: John answered and said, A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus said to him, “Unless you people see signs and wonders, you will never believe.”
occurrences.kjv: Then said Jesus unto him, Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will not believe.

occurrences.bsb: So Jesus replied, “Truly, truly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing by Himself, unless He sees the Father doing it. For whatever the Father does, the Son also does.
occurrences.kjv: Then answered Jesus and said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he seeth the Father do: for what things soever he doeth, these also doeth the Son likewise.

occurrences.bsb: If I testify about Myself, My testimony is not valid.
occurrences.kjv: If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.

occurrences.bsb: I have come in My Father’s name, and you have not received Me; but if someone else comes in his own name, you will receive him.
occurrences.kjv: I am come in my Father’s name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.

occurrences.bsb: “No one can come to Me unless the Father who sent Me draws him, and I will raise him up at the last day.
occurrences.kjv: No man can come to me, except the Father which hath sent me draw him: and I will raise him up at the last day.

occurrences.bsb: I am the living bread that came down from heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. And this bread, which I will give for the life of the world, is My flesh.”
occurrences.kjv: I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.

occurrences.bsb: So Jesus said to them, “Truly, truly, I tell you, unless you eat the flesh and drink the blood of the Son of Man, you have no life in you.
occurrences.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man, and drink his blood, ye have no life in you.

occurrences.bsb: Then what will happen if you see the Son of Man ascend to where He was before?
occurrences.kjv: What and if ye shall see the Son of man ascend up where he was before?

occurrences.bsb: Then Jesus said, “This is why I told you that no one can come to Me unless the Father has granted it to him.”
occurrences.kjv: And he said, Therefore said I unto you, that no man can come unto me, except it were given unto him of my Father.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone desires to do His will, he will know whether My teaching is from God or whether I speak on My own.
occurrences.kjv: If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God, or whether I speak of myself.

occurrences.bsb: On the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood up and called out in a loud voice, “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to Me and drink.
occurrences.kjv: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.

occurrences.bsb: “Does our law convict a man without first hearing from him to determine what he has done?”
occurrences.kjv: Doth our law judge any man, before it hear him, and know what he doeth?

occurrences.bsb: But even if I do judge, My judgment is true, because I am not alone; I am with the Father who sent Me.
occurrences.kjv: And yet if I judge, my judgment is true: for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.

occurrences.bsb: That is why I told you that you would die in your sins. For unless you believe that I am He, you will die in your sins.”
occurrences.kjv: I said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for if ye believe not that I am he, ye shall die in your sins.

occurrences.bsb: So He said to the Jews who had believed Him, “If you continue in My word, you are truly My disciples.
occurrences.kjv: Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him, If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed;

occurrences.bsb: So if the Son sets you free, you will be free indeed.
occurrences.kjv: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.

occurrences.bsb: Truly, truly, I tell you, if anyone keeps My word, he will never see death.”
occurrences.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my saying, he shall never see death.

occurrences.bsb: “Now we know that You have a demon!” declared the Jews. “Abraham died, and so did the prophets, yet You say that anyone who keeps Your word will never taste death.
occurrences.kjv: Then said the Jews unto him, Now we know that thou hast a devil. Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and thou sayest, If a man keep my saying, he shall never taste of death.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus answered, “If I glorify Myself, My glory means nothing. The One who glorifies Me is My Father, of whom you say, ‘He is our God.’
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered, If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honoureth me; of whom ye say, that he is your God:

occurrences.bsb: His parents said this because they were afraid of the Jews. For the Jews had already determined that anyone who confessed Jesus as the Christ would be put out of the synagogue.
occurrences.kjv: These words spake his parents, because they feared the Jews: for the Jews had agreed already, that if any man did confess that he was Christ, he should be put out of the synagogue.

occurrences.bsb: We know that God does not listen to sinners, but He does listen to the one who worships Him and does His will.
occurrences.kjv: Now we know that God heareth not sinners: but if any man be a worshipper of God, and doeth his will, him he heareth.

occurrences.bsb: I am the gate. If anyone enters through Me, he will be saved. He will come in and go out and find pasture.
occurrences.kjv: I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus answered, “Are there not twelve hours of daylight? If anyone walks in the daytime, he will not stumble, because he sees by the light of this world.
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If any man walk in the day, he stumbleth not, because he seeth the light of this world.

occurrences.bsb: But if anyone walks at night, he will stumble, because he has no light.”
occurrences.kjv: But if a man walk in the night, he stumbleth, because there is no light in him.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus replied, “Did I not tell you that if you believed, you would see the glory of God?”
occurrences.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou wouldest believe, thou shouldest see the glory of God?

occurrences.bsb: If we let Him go on like this, everyone will believe in Him, and then the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation.”
occurrences.kjv: If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.

occurrences.bsb: But the chief priests and Pharisees had given orders that anyone who knew where He was must report it, so that they could arrest Him.
occurrences.kjv: Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a commandment, that, if any man knew where he were, he should shew it, that they might take him.

occurrences.bsb: Truly, truly, I tell you, unless a kernel of wheat falls to the ground and dies, it remains only a seed. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.
occurrences.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone serves Me, he must follow Me; and where I am, My servant will be as well. If anyone serves Me, the Father will honor him.
occurrences.kjv: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will my Father honour.

occurrences.bsb: And I, when I am lifted up from the earth, will draw everyone to Myself.”
occurrences.kjv: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto me.

occurrences.bsb: As for anyone who hears My words and does not keep them, I do not judge him. For I have not come to judge the world, but to save the world.
occurrences.kjv: And if any man hear my words, and believe not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.

occurrences.bsb: “Never shall You wash my feet!” Peter told Him. Jesus answered, “Unless I wash you, you have no part with Me.”
occurrences.kjv: Peter saith unto him, Thou shalt never wash my feet. Jesus answered him, If I wash thee not, thou hast no part with me.

occurrences.bsb: If you know these things, you will be blessed if you do them.
occurrences.kjv: If ye know these things, happy are ye if ye do them.

occurrences.bsb: By this everyone will know that you are My disciples, if you love one another.”
occurrences.kjv: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.

occurrences.bsb: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come back and welcome you into My presence, so that you also may be where I am.
occurrences.kjv: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.

occurrences.bsb: If you ask Me for anything in My name, I will do it.
occurrences.kjv: If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.

occurrences.bsb: If you love Me, you will keep My commandments.
occurrences.kjv: If ye love me, keep my commandments.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus replied, “If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word. My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make Our home with him.
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.

occurrences.bsb: Remain in Me, and I will remain in you. Just as no branch can bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, neither can you bear fruit unless you remain in Me.
occurrences.kjv: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone does not remain in Me, he is like a branch that is thrown away and withers. Such branches are gathered up, thrown into the fire, and burned.
occurrences.kjv: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and men gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.

occurrences.bsb: If you remain in Me and My words remain in you, ask whatever you wish, and it will be done for you.
occurrences.kjv: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you.

occurrences.bsb: If you keep My commandments, you will remain in My love, just as I have kept My Father’s commandments and remain in His love.
occurrences.kjv: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father’s commandments, and abide in his love.

occurrences.bsb: You are My friends if you do what I command you.
occurrences.kjv: Ye are my friends, if ye do whatsoever I command you.

occurrences.bsb: But I tell you the truth, it is for your benefit that I am going away. Unless I go away, the Advocate will not come to you; but if I go, I will send Him to you.
occurrences.kjv: Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I depart, I will send him unto you.

occurrences.bsb: From then on, Pilate tried to release Him, but the Jews kept shouting, “If you release this man, you are no friend of Caesar. Anyone who declares himself a king is defying Caesar.”
occurrences.kjv: And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him: but the Jews cried out, saying, If thou let this man go, thou art not Cesar’s friend: whosoever maketh himself a king speaketh against Cesar.

occurrences.bsb: So the other disciples told him, “We have seen the Lord!” But he replied, “Unless I see the nail marks in His hands, and put my finger where the nails have been, and put my hand into His side, I will never believe.”
occurrences.kjv: The other disciples therefore said unto him, We have seen the Lord. But he said unto them, Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust my hand into his side, I will not believe.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus answered, “If I want him to remain until I return, what is that to you? You follow Me!”
occurrences.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee? follow thou me.

occurrences.bsb: Because of this, the rumor spread among the brothers that this disciple would not die. However, Jesus did not say that he would not die, but only, “If I want him to remain until I return, what is that to you?”
occurrences.kjv: Then went this saying abroad among the brethren, that that disciple should not die: yet Jesus said not unto him, He shall not die; but, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee?

occurrences.bsb: There are many more things that Jesus did. If all of them were written down, I suppose that not even the world itself would have space for the books that would be written.
occurrences.kjv: And there are also many other things which Jesus did, the which, if they should be written every one, I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that should be written. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: So in the present case I advise you: Leave these men alone. Let them go! For if their purpose or endeavor is of human origin, it will fail.
occurrences.kjv: And now I say unto you, Refrain from these men, and let them alone: for if this counsel or this work be of men, it will come to nought:

occurrences.bsb: ‘But I will punish the nation that enslaves them,’ God said, ‘and afterward they will come forth and worship Me in this place.’
occurrences.kjv: And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge, said God: and after that shall they come forth, and serve me in this place.

occurrences.bsb: “Give me this power as well,” he said, “so that everyone on whom I lay my hands may receive the Holy Spirit.”
occurrences.kjv: Saying, Give me also this power, that on whomsoever I lay hands, he may receive the Holy Ghost.

occurrences.bsb: “How can I,” he said, “unless someone guides me?” And he invited Philip to come up and sit with him.
occurrences.kjv: And he said, How can I, except some man should guide me? And he desired Philip that he would come up and sit with him.

occurrences.bsb: and requested letters to the synagogues in Damascus, so that if he found any men or women belonging to the Way, he could bring them as prisoners to Jerusalem.
occurrences.kjv: And desired of him letters to Damascus to the synagogues, that if he found any of this way, whether they were men or women, he might bring them bound unto Jerusalem.

occurrences.bsb: ‘Look, you scoffers, wonder and perish! For I am doing a work in your days that you would never believe, even if someone told you.’”
occurrences.kjv: Behold, ye despisers, and wonder, and perish: for I work a work in your days, a work which ye shall in no wise believe, though a man declare it unto you.

occurrences.bsb: Then some men came down from Judea and were teaching the brothers, “Unless you are circumcised according to the custom of Moses, you cannot be saved.”
occurrences.kjv: And certain men which came down from Judea taught the brethren, and said, Except ye be circumcised after the manner of Moses, ye cannot be saved.

occurrences.bsb: They have known me for a long time and can testify, if they are willing, that I lived as a Pharisee, adhering to the strictest sect of our religion.
occurrences.kjv: Which knew me from the beginning, if they would testify, that after the most straitest sect of our religion I lived a Pharisee.

occurrences.bsb: But Paul said to the centurion and the soldiers, “Unless these men remain with the ship, you cannot be saved.”
occurrences.kjv: Paul said to the centurion and to the soldiers, Except these abide in the ship, ye cannot be saved.

occurrences.bsb: Circumcision has value if you observe the law, but if you break the law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.
occurrences.kjv: For circumcision verily profiteth, if thou keep the law: but if thou be a breaker of the law, thy circumcision is made uncircumcision.

occurrences.bsb: If a man who is not circumcised keeps the requirements of the law, will not his uncircumcision be regarded as circumcision?
occurrences.kjv: Therefore if the uncircumcision keep the righteousness of the law, shall not his uncircumcision be counted for circumcision?

occurrences.bsb: For instance, a married woman is bound by law to her husband as long as he lives. But if her husband dies, she is released from the law of marriage.
occurrences.kjv: For the woman which hath an husband is bound by the law to her husband so long as he liveth; but if the husband be dead, she is loosed from the law of her husband.

occurrences.bsb: So then, if she is joined to another man while her husband is still alive, she is called an adulteress; but if her husband dies, she is free from that law and is not an adulteress if she marries another man.
occurrences.kjv: So then if, while her husband liveth, she be married to another man, she shall be called an adulteress: but if her husband be dead, she is free from that law; so that she is no adulteress, though she be married to another man.

occurrences.bsb: Isaiah cries out concerning Israel: “Though the number of the Israelites is like the sand of the sea, only the remnant will be saved.
occurrences.kjv: Esaias also crieth concerning Israel, Though the number of the children of Israel be as the sand of the sea, a remnant shall be saved:

occurrences.bsb: that if you confess with your mouth, “Jesus is Lord,” and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead, you will be saved.
occurrences.kjv: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.

occurrences.bsb: And how can they preach unless they are sent? As it is written: “How beautiful are the feet of those who bring good news!”
occurrences.kjv: And how shall they preach, except they be sent? as it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!

occurrences.bsb: Take notice, therefore, of the kindness and severity of God: severity to those who fell, but kindness to you, if you continue in His kindness. Otherwise you also will be cut off.
occurrences.kjv: Behold therefore the goodness and severity of God: on them which fell, severity; but toward thee, goodness, if thou continue in his goodness: otherwise thou also shalt be cut off.

occurrences.bsb: And if they do not persist in unbelief, they will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.
occurrences.kjv: And they also, if they abide not still in unbelief, shall be graffed in: for God is able to graff them in again.

occurrences.bsb: On the contrary, “If your enemy is hungry, feed him; if he is thirsty, give him a drink. For in so doing, you will heap burning coals on his head.”
occurrences.kjv: Therefore if thine enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him drink: for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire on his head.

occurrences.bsb: For he is God’s servant for your good. But if you do wrong, be afraid, for he does not carry the sword in vain. He is God’s servant, an agent of retribution to the wrongdoer.
occurrences.kjv: For he is the minister of God to thee for good. But if thou do that which is evil, be afraid; for he beareth not the sword in vain: for he is the minister of God, a revenger to execute wrath upon him that doeth evil.

occurrences.bsb: If we live, we live to the Lord, and if we die, we die to the Lord. So whether we live or die, we belong to the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: For whether we live, we live unto the Lord; and whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are the Lord’s.

occurrences.bsb: But the one who has doubts is condemned if he eats, because his eating is not from faith; and everything that is not from faith is sin.
occurrences.kjv: And he that doubteth is damned if he eat, because he eateth not of faith: for whatsoever is not of faith is sin.

occurrences.bsb: I hope to see you on my way to Spain. And after I have enjoyed your company for a while, you can equip me for my journey.
occurrences.kjv: Whensoever I take my journey into Spain, I will come to you: for I trust to see you in my journey, and to be brought on my way thitherward by you, if first I be somewhat filled with your company.

occurrences.bsb: Even if you have ten thousand guardians in Christ, you do not have many fathers; for in Christ Jesus I became your father through the gospel.
occurrences.kjv: For though ye have ten thousand instructors in Christ, yet have ye not many fathers: for in Christ Jesus I have begotten you through the gospel.

occurrences.bsb: But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord is willing, and then I will find out not only what these arrogant people are saying, but what power they have.
occurrences.kjv: But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord will, and will know, not the speech of them which are puffed up, but the power.

occurrences.bsb: But now I am writing you not to associate with anyone who claims to be a brother but is sexually immoral or greedy, an idolater or a verbal abuser, a drunkard or a swindler. With such a man do not even eat.
occurrences.kjv: But now I have written unto you not to keep company, if any man that is called a brother be a fornicator, or covetous, or an idolater, or a railer, or a drunkard, or an extortioner; with such an one no not to eat.

occurrences.bsb: So if you need to settle everyday matters, do you appoint as judges those of no standing in the church?
occurrences.kjv: If then ye have judgments of things pertaining to this life, set them to judge who are least esteemed in the church.

occurrences.bsb: Flee from sexual immorality. Every other sin a man can commit is outside his body, but he who sins sexually sins against his own body.
occurrences.kjv: Flee fornication. Every sin that a man doeth is without the body; but he that committeth fornication sinneth against his own body.

occurrences.bsb: Now to the unmarried and widows I say this: It is good for them to remain unmarried, as I am.
occurrences.kjv: I say therefore to the unmarried and widows, It is good for them if they abide even as I.

occurrences.bsb: But if she does, she must remain unmarried or else be reconciled to her husband. And a husband must not divorce his wife.
occurrences.kjv: But and if she depart, let her remain unmarried, or be reconciled to her husband: and let not the husband put away his wife.

occurrences.bsb: But if you do marry, you have not sinned. And if a virgin marries, she has not sinned. But those who marry will face troubles in this life, and I want to spare you this.
occurrences.kjv: But and if thou marry, thou hast not sinned; and if a virgin marry, she hath not sinned. Nevertheless such shall have trouble in the flesh: but I spare you.

occurrences.bsb: However, if someone thinks he is acting inappropriately toward his betrothed, and if she is beyond her youth and they ought to marry, let him do as he wishes; he is not sinning; they should get married.
occurrences.kjv: But if any man think that he behaveth himself uncomely toward his virgin, if she pass the flower of her age, and need so require, let him do what he will, he sinneth not: let them marry.

occurrences.bsb: A wife is bound to her husband as long as he lives. But if her husband dies, she is free to marry anyone she wishes, as long as he belongs to the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: The wife is bound by the law as long as her husband liveth; but if her husband be dead, she is at liberty to be married to whom she will; only in the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: In my judgment, however, she is happier if she remains as she is. And I think that I too have the Spirit of God.
occurrences.kjv: But she is happier if she so abide, after my judgment: and I think also that I have the Spirit of God.

occurrences.bsb: But food does not bring us closer to God: We are no worse if we do not eat, and no better if we do.
occurrences.kjv: But meat commendeth us not to God: for neither, if we eat, are we the better; neither, if we eat not, are we the worse.

occurrences.bsb: For if someone with a weak conscience sees you who are well informed eating in an idol’s temple, will he not be encouraged to eat food sacrificed to idols?
occurrences.kjv: For if any man see thee which hast knowledge sit at meat in the idol’s temple, shall not the conscience of him which is weak be emboldened to eat those things which are offered to idols;

occurrences.bsb: Yet when I preach the gospel, I have no reason to boast, because I am obligated to preach. Woe to me if I do not preach the gospel!
occurrences.kjv: For though I preach the gospel, I have nothing to glory of: for necessity is laid upon me; yea, woe is unto me, if I preach not the gospel!

occurrences.bsb: But if someone tells you, “This food was offered to idols,” then do not eat it, for the sake of the one who told you and for the sake of conscience—
occurrences.kjv: But if any man say unto you, This is offered in sacrifice unto idols, eat not for his sake that shewed it, and for conscience sake: for the earth is the Lord’s, and the fulness thereof:

occurrences.bsb: Doesn’t nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a disgrace to him,
occurrences.kjv: Doth not even nature itself teach you, that, if a man have long hair, it is a shame unto him?

occurrences.bsb: but that if a woman has long hair, it is her glory? For long hair is given to her as a covering.
occurrences.kjv: But if a woman have long hair, it is a glory to her: for her hair is given her for a covering.

occurrences.bsb: In the same way, after supper He took the cup, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in My blood; do this, as often as you drink it, in remembrance of Me.”
occurrences.kjv: After the same manner also he took the cup, when he had supped, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood: this do ye, as oft as ye drink it, in remembrance of me.

occurrences.bsb: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until He comes.
occurrences.kjv: For as often as ye eat this bread, and drink this cup, ye do shew the Lord’s death till he come.

occurrences.bsb: If the foot should say, “Because I am not a hand, I do not belong to the body,” that would not make it any less a part of the body.
occurrences.kjv: If the foot shall say, Because I am not the hand, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?

occurrences.bsb: And if the ear should say, “Because I am not an eye, I do not belong to the body,” that would not make it any less a part of the body.
occurrences.kjv: And if the ear shall say, Because I am not the eye, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?

occurrences.bsb: If I speak in the tongues of men and of angels, but have not love, I am only a ringing gong or a clanging cymbal.
occurrences.kjv: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, and have not charity, I am become as sounding brass, or a tinkling cymbal.

occurrences.bsb: If I have the gift of prophecy and can fathom all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have absolute faith so as to move mountains, but have not love, I am nothing.
occurrences.kjv: And though I have the gift of prophecy, and understand all mysteries, and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, and have not charity, I am nothing.

occurrences.bsb: If I give all I possess to the poor and exult in the surrender of my body, but have not love, I gain nothing.
occurrences.kjv: And though I bestow all my goods to feed the poor, and though I give my body to be burned, and have not charity, it profiteth me nothing.

occurrences.bsb: Now, brothers, if I come to you speaking in tongues, how will I benefit you, unless I bring you some revelation or knowledge or prophecy or teaching?
occurrences.kjv: Now, brethren, if I come unto you speaking with tongues, what shall I profit you, except I shall speak to you either by revelation, or by knowledge, or by prophesying, or by doctrine?

occurrences.bsb: Even in the case of lifeless instruments, such as the flute or harp, how will anyone recognize the tune they are playing unless the notes are distinct?
occurrences.kjv: And even things without life giving sound, whether pipe or harp, except they give a distinction in the sounds, how shall it be known what is piped or harped?

occurrences.bsb: Again, if the trumpet sounds a muffled call, who will prepare for battle?
occurrences.kjv: For if the trumpet give an uncertain sound, who shall prepare himself to the battle?

occurrences.bsb: So it is with you. Unless you speak intelligible words with your tongue, how will anyone know what you are saying? You will just be speaking into the air.
occurrences.kjv: So likewise ye, except ye utter by the tongue words easy to be understood, how shall it be known what is spoken? for ye shall speak into the air.

occurrences.bsb: If, then, I do not know the meaning of someone’s language, I am a foreigner to the speaker, and he is a foreigner to me.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore if I know not the meaning of the voice, I shall be unto him that speaketh a barbarian, and he that speaketh shall be a barbarian unto me.

occurrences.bsb: For if I pray in a tongue, my spirit prays, but my mind is unfruitful.
occurrences.kjv: For if I pray in an unknown tongue, my spirit prayeth, but my understanding is unfruitful.

occurrences.bsb: Otherwise, if you speak a blessing in spirit, how can someone who is uninstructed say “Amen” to your thanksgiving, since he does not know what you are saying?
occurrences.kjv: Else when thou shalt bless with the spirit, how shall he that occupieth the room of the unlearned say Amen at thy giving of thanks, seeing he understandeth not what thou sayest?

occurrences.bsb: So if the whole church comes together and everyone speaks in tongues, and some who are uninstructed or some unbelievers come in, will they not say that you are out of your minds?
occurrences.kjv: If therefore the whole church be come together into one place, and all speak with tongues, and there come in those that are unlearned, or unbelievers, will they not say that ye are mad?

occurrences.bsb: But if an unbeliever or uninstructed person comes in while everyone is prophesying, he will be convicted and called to account by all,
occurrences.kjv: But if all prophesy, and there come in one that believeth not, or one unlearned, he is convinced of all, he is judged of all:

occurrences.bsb: But if there is no interpreter, he should remain silent in the church and speak only to himself and God.
occurrences.kjv: But if there be no interpreter, let him keep silence in the church; and let him speak to himself, and to God.

occurrences.bsb: And if a revelation comes to someone who is seated, the first speaker should stop.
occurrences.kjv: If any thing be revealed to another that sitteth by, let the first hold his peace.

occurrences.bsb: You fool! What you sow does not come to life unless it dies.
occurrences.kjv: Thou fool, that which thou sowest is not quickened, except it die:

occurrences.bsb: On the first day of every week, each of you should set aside a portion of his income, saving it up, so that when I come no collections will be needed.
occurrences.kjv: Upon the first day of the week let every one of you lay by him in store, as God hath prospered him, that there be no gatherings when I come.

occurrences.bsb: Then, on my arrival, I will send letters with those you recommend to carry your gift to Jerusalem.
occurrences.kjv: And when I come, whomsoever ye shall approve by your letters, them will I send to bring your liberality unto Jerusalem.

occurrences.bsb: And if it is advisable for me to go also, they can travel with me.
occurrences.kjv: And if it be meet that I go also, they shall go with me.

occurrences.bsb: Perhaps I will stay with you awhile, or even spend the winter, so that you can help me on my journey, wherever I go.
occurrences.kjv: And it may be that I will abide, yea, and winter with you, that ye may bring me on my journey whithersoever I go.

occurrences.bsb: For I do not want to see you now only in passing; I hope to spend some time with you, if the Lord permits.
occurrences.kjv: For I will not see you now by the way; but I trust to tarry a while with you, if the Lord permit.

occurrences.bsb: If Timothy comes, see to it that he has nothing to fear while he is with you, for he is doing the work of the Lord, just as I am.
occurrences.kjv: Now if Timotheus come, see that he may be with you without fear: for he worketh the work of the Lord, as I also do.

occurrences.bsb: But whenever anyone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.
occurrences.kjv: Nevertheless when it shall turn to the Lord, the vail shall be taken away.

occurrences.bsb: For we know that if the earthly tent we live in is dismantled, we have a building from God, an eternal house in heaven, not built by human hands.
occurrences.kjv: For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.

occurrences.bsb: For if the eagerness is there, the gift is acceptable according to what one has, not according to what he does not have.
occurrences.kjv: For if there be first a willing mind, it is accepted according to that a man hath, and not according to that he hath not.

occurrences.bsb: Otherwise, if any Macedonians come with me and find you unprepared, we—to say nothing of you—would be ashamed of having been so confident.
occurrences.kjv: Lest haply if they of Macedonia come with me, and find you unprepared, we (that we say not, ye) should be ashamed in this same confident boasting.

occurrences.bsb: For even if I boast somewhat excessively about the authority the Lord gave us for building you up rather than tearing you down, I will not be ashamed.
occurrences.kjv: For though I should boast somewhat more of our authority, which the Lord hath given us for edification, and not for your destruction, I should not be ashamed:

occurrences.bsb: Even if I wanted to boast, I would not be a fool, because I would be speaking the truth. But I refrain, so no one will credit me with more than he sees in me or hears from me,
occurrences.kjv: For though I would desire to glory, I shall not be a fool; for I will say the truth: but now I forbear, lest any man should think of me above that which he seeth me to be, or that he heareth of me.

occurrences.bsb: I already warned you the second time I was with you. So now in my absence I warn those who sinned earlier and everyone else: If I return, I will not spare anyone,
occurrences.kjv: I told you before, and foretell you, as if I were present, the second time; and being absent now I write to them which heretofore have sinned, and to all other, that, if I come again, I will not spare:

occurrences.bsb: But even if we or an angel from heaven should preach a gospel contrary to the one we preached to you, let him be under a curse!
occurrences.kjv: But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed.

occurrences.bsb: know that a man is not justified by works of the law, but by faith in Jesus Christ. So we, too, have believed in Christ Jesus, that we may be justified by faith in Christ and not by works of the law, because by works of the law no one will be justified.
occurrences.kjv: Knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law, but by the faith of Jesus Christ, even we have believed in Jesus Christ, that we might be justified by the faith of Christ, and not by the works of the law: for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified.

occurrences.bsb: Take notice: I, Paul, tell you that if you let yourselves be circumcised, Christ will be of no value to you at all.
occurrences.kjv: Behold, I Paul say unto you, that if ye be circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing.

occurrences.bsb: I am confident in the Lord that you will take no other view. The one who is troubling you will bear the judgment, whoever he may be.
occurrences.kjv: I have confidence in you through the Lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.

occurrences.bsb: For the flesh craves what is contrary to the Spirit, and the Spirit what is contrary to the flesh. They are opposed to each other, so that you do not do what you want.
occurrences.kjv: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh: and these are contrary the one to the other: so that ye cannot do the things that ye would.

occurrences.bsb: Brothers, if someone is caught in a trespass, you who are spiritual should restore him with a spirit of gentleness. But watch yourself, or you also may be tempted.
occurrences.kjv: Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted.

occurrences.bsb: Do not be deceived: God is not to be mocked. Whatever a man sows, he will reap in return.
occurrences.kjv: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.

occurrences.bsb: Bear with one another and forgive any complaint you may have against someone else. Forgive as the Lord forgave you.
occurrences.kjv: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.

occurrences.bsb: And whatever you do, in word or deed, do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through Him.
occurrences.kjv: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.

occurrences.bsb: Whatever you do, work at it with your whole being, as for the Lord and not for men,
occurrences.kjv: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;

occurrences.bsb: My fellow prisoner Aristarchus sends you greetings, as does Mark the cousin of Barnabas. You have already received instructions about him: If he comes to you, welcome him.
occurrences.kjv: Aristarchus my fellowprisoner saluteth you, and Marcus, sister’s son to Barnabas, (touching whom ye received commandments: if he come unto you, receive him;)

occurrences.bsb: On the contrary, we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother caring for her children.
occurrences.kjv: But we were gentle among you, even as a nurse cherisheth her children:

occurrences.bsb: For now we can go on living, as long as you are standing firm in the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: For now we live, if ye stand fast in the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: Let no one deceive you in any way, for it will not come until the rebellion occurs and the man of lawlessness—the son of destruction—is revealed.
occurrences.kjv: Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition;

occurrences.bsb: Now we know that the law is good, if one uses it legitimately.
occurrences.kjv: But we know that the law is good, if a man use it lawfully;

occurrences.bsb: Women, however, will be saved through childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and holiness, with self-control.
occurrences.kjv: Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing, if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety.

occurrences.bsb: in case I am delayed, so that you will know how each one must conduct himself in God’s household, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and foundation of the truth.
occurrences.kjv: But if I tarry long, that thou mayest know how thou oughtest to behave thyself in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.

occurrences.bsb: Likewise, a competitor does not receive the crown unless he competes according to the rules.
occurrences.kjv: And if a man also strive for masteries, yet is he not crowned, except he strive lawfully.

occurrences.bsb: So if anyone cleanses himself of what is unfit, he will be a vessel for honor: sanctified, useful to the Master, and prepared for every good work.
occurrences.kjv: If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master’s use, and prepared unto every good work.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, as the Holy Spirit says: “Today, if you hear His voice,
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore (as the Holy Ghost saith, To day if ye will hear his voice,

occurrences.bsb: We have come to share in Christ if we hold firmly to the end the assurance we had at first.
occurrences.kjv: For we are made partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence stedfast unto the end;

occurrences.bsb: As it has been said: “Today, if you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts, as you did in the rebellion.”
occurrences.kjv: While it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation.

occurrences.bsb: God again designated a certain day as “Today,” when a long time later He spoke through David as was just stated: “Today, if you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts.”
occurrences.kjv: Again, he limiteth a certain day, saying in David, To day, after so long a time; as it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts.

occurrences.bsb: And this we will do, if God permits.
occurrences.kjv: And this will we do, if God permit.

occurrences.bsb: But My righteous one will live by faith; and if he shrinks back, I will take no pleasure in him.”
occurrences.kjv: Now the just shall live by faith: but if any man draw back, my soul shall have no pleasure in him.

occurrences.bsb: Be aware that our brother Timothy has been released. If he arrives soon, I will come with him to see you.
occurrences.kjv: Know ye that our brother Timothy is set at liberty; with whom, if he come shortly, I will see you.

occurrences.bsb: Suppose a man comes into your meeting wearing a gold ring and fine clothes, and a poor man in shabby clothes also comes in.
occurrences.kjv: For if there come unto your assembly a man with a gold ring, in goodly apparel, and there come in also a poor man in vile raiment;

occurrences.bsb: What good is it, my brothers, if someone claims to have faith, but has no deeds? Can such faith save him?
occurrences.kjv: What doth it profit, my brethren, though a man say he hath faith, and have not works? can faith save him?

occurrences.bsb: Suppose a brother or sister is without clothes and daily food.
occurrences.kjv: If a brother or sister be naked, and destitute of daily food,

occurrences.bsb: So too, faith by itself, if it does not result in action, is dead.
occurrences.kjv: Even so faith, if it hath not works, is dead, being alone.

occurrences.bsb: You adulteresses! Do you not know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Therefore, whoever chooses to be a friend of the world renders himself an enemy of God.
occurrences.kjv: Ye adulterers and adulteresses, know ye not that the friendship of the world is enmity with God? whosoever therefore will be a friend of the world is the enemy of God.

occurrences.bsb: Instead, you ought to say, “If the Lord is willing, we will live and do this or that.”
occurrences.kjv: For that ye ought to say, If the Lord will, we shall live, and do this, or that.

occurrences.bsb: My brothers, if one of you should wander from the truth and someone should bring him back,
occurrences.kjv: Brethren, if any of you do err from the truth, and one convert him;

occurrences.bsb: Who can harm you if you are zealous for what is good?
occurrences.kjv: And who is he that will harm you, if ye be followers of that which is good?

occurrences.bsb: If we say we have fellowship with Him yet walk in the darkness, we lie and do not practice the truth.
occurrences.kjv: If we say that we have fellowship with him, and walk in darkness, we lie, and do not the truth:

occurrences.bsb: But if we walk in the light as He is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus His Son cleanses us from all sin.
occurrences.kjv: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.

occurrences.bsb: If we say we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
occurrences.kjv: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

occurrences.bsb: If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
occurrences.kjv: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

occurrences.bsb: If we say we have not sinned, we make Him out to be a liar, and His word is not in us.
occurrences.kjv: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.

occurrences.bsb: My little children, I am writing these things to you so that you will not sin. But if anyone does sin, we have an advocate before the Father—Jesus Christ, the Righteous One.
occurrences.kjv: My little children, these things write I unto you, that ye sin not. And if any man sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:

occurrences.bsb: By this we can be sure that we have come to know Him: if we keep His commandments.
occurrences.kjv: And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.

occurrences.bsb: Do not love the world or anything in the world. If anyone loves the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
occurrences.kjv: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.

occurrences.bsb: As for you, let what you have heard from the beginning remain in you. If it does, you will also remain in the Son and in the Father.
occurrences.kjv: Let that therefore abide in you, which ye have heard from the beginning. If that which ye have heard from the beginning shall remain in you, ye also shall continue in the Son, and in the Father.

occurrences.bsb: And now, little children, remain in Christ, so that when He appears, we may be confident and unashamed before Him at His coming.
occurrences.kjv: And now, little children, abide in him; that, when he shall appear, we may have confidence, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.

occurrences.bsb: If you know that He is righteous, you also know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of Him.
occurrences.kjv: If ye know that he is righteous, ye know that every one that doeth righteousness is born of him.

occurrences.bsb: Beloved, we are now children of God, and what we will be has not yet been revealed. We know that when Christ appears, we will be like Him, for we will see Him as He is.
occurrences.kjv: Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it doth not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.

occurrences.bsb: Even if our hearts condemn us, God is greater than our hearts, and He knows all things.
occurrences.kjv: For if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.

occurrences.bsb: Beloved, if our hearts do not condemn us, we have confidence before God,
occurrences.kjv: Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, then have we confidence toward God.

occurrences.bsb: and we will receive from Him whatever we ask, because we keep His commandments and do what is pleasing in His sight.
occurrences.kjv: And whatsoever we ask, we receive of him, because we keep his commandments, and do those things that are pleasing in his sight.

occurrences.bsb: No one has ever seen God; but if we love one another, God remains in us, and His love is perfected in us.
occurrences.kjv: No man hath seen God at any time. If we love one another, God dwelleth in us, and his love is perfected in us.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God abides in him, and he in God.
occurrences.kjv: Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God dwelleth in him, and he in God.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone says, “I love God,” but hates his brother, he is a liar. For anyone who does not love his brother, whom he has seen, cannot love God, whom he has not seen.
occurrences.kjv: If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, how can he love God whom he hath not seen?

occurrences.bsb: And this is the confidence that we have before Him: If we ask anything according to His will, He hears us.
occurrences.kjv: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us:

occurrences.bsb: And if we know that He hears us in whatever we ask, we know that we already possess what we have asked of Him.
occurrences.kjv: And if we know that he hear us, whatsoever we ask, we know that we have the petitions that we desired of him.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone sees his brother committing a sin not leading to death, he should ask God, who will give life to those who commit this kind of sin. There is a sin that leads to death; I am not saying he should ask regarding that sin.
occurrences.kjv: If any man see his brother sin a sin which is not unto death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: I do not say that he shall pray for it.

occurrences.bsb: Beloved, you are faithful in what you are doing for the brothers, and especially since they are strangers to you.
occurrences.kjv: Beloved, thou doest faithfully whatsoever thou doest to the brethren, and to strangers;

occurrences.bsb: So if I come, I will call attention to his malicious slander against us. And unsatisfied with that, he refuses to welcome the brothers and forbids those who want to do so, even putting them out of the church.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore, if I come, I will remember his deeds which he doeth, prating against us with malicious words: and not content therewith, neither doth he himself receive the brethren, and forbiddeth them that would, and casteth them out of the church.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, keep in mind how far you have fallen. Repent and perform the deeds you did at first. But if you do not repent, I will come to you and remove your lampstand from its place.
occurrences.kjv: Remember therefore from whence thou art fallen, and repent, and do the first works; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will remove thy candlestick out of his place, except thou repent.

occurrences.bsb: Behold, I will cast her onto a bed of sickness, and those who commit adultery with her will suffer great tribulation unless they repent of her deeds.
occurrences.kjv: Behold, I will cast her into a bed, and them that commit adultery with her into great tribulation, except they repent of their deeds.

occurrences.bsb: Remember, then, what you have received and heard. Keep it and repent. If you do not wake up, I will come like a thief, and you will not know the hour when I will come upon you.
occurrences.kjv: Remember therefore how thou hast received and heard, and hold fast, and repent. If therefore thou shalt not watch, I will come on thee as a thief, and thou shalt not know what hour I will come upon thee.

occurrences.bsb: Those I love I rebuke and discipline. Therefore be earnest and repent.
occurrences.kjv: As many as I love, I rebuke and chasten: be zealous therefore, and repent.

occurrences.bsb: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears My voice and opens the door, I will come in and dine with him, and he with Me.
occurrences.kjv: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.

occurrences.bsb: These witnesses have power to shut the sky so that no rain will fall during the days of their prophecy, and power to turn the waters into blood and to strike the earth with every kind of plague as often as they wish.
occurrences.kjv: These have power to shut heaven, that it rain not in the days of their prophecy: and have power over waters to turn them to blood, and to smite the earth with all plagues, as often as they will.

occurrences.bsb: The second beast was permitted to give breath to the image of the first beast, so that the image could speak and cause all who refused to worship it to be killed.
occurrences.kjv: And he had power to give life unto the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause that as many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed.

occurrences.bsb: I testify to everyone who hears the words of prophecy in this book: If anyone adds to them, God will add to him the plagues described in this book.
occurrences.kjv: For I testify unto every man that heareth the words of the prophecy of this book, If any man shall add unto these things, God shall add unto him the plagues that are written in this book:

occurrences.bsb: And if anyone takes away from the words of this book of prophecy, God will take away his share in the tree of life and the holy city, which are described in this book.
occurrences.kjv: And if any man shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God shall take away his part out of the book of life, and out of the holy city, and from the things which are written in this book.
